title: GoldenBraid plasmid files
credit: Dictyostelium GoldenBraid kit, Shaulsky lab (Baylor College of Medicine).
format: SnapGene .dna files (open in SnapGene or the free SnapGene Viewer).

groups.title: Assemblies
groups.blurb: Assembled GoldenBraid plasmids: transcriptional units and multi-unit constructs.

groups.title: Backbones
groups.blurb: GoldenBraid destination vectors (pDGB alpha and omega backbones, and pUPD2).

groups.title: Parts
groups.blurb: Domesticated parts: promoters, coding sequences, tags and terminators.

groups.title: Legacy constructs
groups.blurb: Earlier pBSK-based versions of the assemblies.

groups.title: Legacy actin8 terminator
groups.blurb: Earlier pBSK-based constructs that use the actin8 terminator.
